'''Ian Fraser Putnam''' is a mathematician whose research focus on the intersection between [[dynamical system]]s and [[algebra]], including [[C*-algebra]]s and [[K-theory]]. He is a professor at the [[University of Victoria]].<ref>{{cite web | title=Ian Putnam | website=UVic.ca | url=https://www.uvic.ca/science/math-statistics/people/home/faculty/putnam_ian.php | ref={{sfnref|UVic.ca}} | access-date=2026-04-10}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | title=Ian Putnam: Research | website=UVic.ca | date=2011-12-29 | url=https://web.uvic.ca/~ifputnam/r/res.html#interests | ref={{sfnref|UVic.ca|2011}} | access-date=2026-04-10}}</ref>

== Education ==

He obtained his PhD at the [[University of California, Berkeley]] in 1985, with [[Marc Rieffel|Marc Aristide Rieffel]] as advisor (thesis ''The C*-algebras Associated with Denjoy Homeomorphisms'').<ref>{{MathGenealogy|id=25121}}</ref>

== Honours ==

*[[Israel Halperin Prize]] in 1990.<ref>{{cite web | title=The Israel Halperin Prize | website=Mathematics | url=https://www.math.uwaterloo.ca/~krdavids/IsraelHalperinPrize.html | ref={{sfnref|Mathematics}} | access-date=2026-04-10}}</ref>
*[[Aisenstadt Prize]] in 1993.<ref>{{cite web | title=André Aisenstadt Prize | website=Site officiel du Centre de recherches mathématiques (CRM) | date=2025-10-14 | url=https://www.crmath.ca/en/prizes-and-honours/andre-aisenstadt-prize/ | ref={{sfnref|Site officiel du Centre de recherches mathématiques (CRM)|2025}} | access-date=2026-04-10}}</ref>
*Fellow of the [[Royal Society of Canada]].<ref>{{cite web | title=Find Members | website=The Royal Society of Canada | url=https://rsc-src.ca/en/find-rsc-member/results?search_api_views_fulltext=putnam | ref={{sfnref|The Royal Society of Canada}} | access-date=2026-04-10}}</ref>
*Fellow of the [[American Mathematical Society]] since 2013 (inaugural class).<ref>[https://www.ams.org/cgi-bin/fellows/fellows.cgi AMS website, "List of Fellows of the American Mathematical Society"] (Wayback Machine archived version)</ref>

== Selected publications ==

*GIORDANO, Thierry; PUTNAM, Ian F.; SKAU, Christian F. "Topological orbit equivalence and C*-crossed products". 1995.
*ANDERSON, Jared E.; PUTNAM, Ian F. "Topological invariants for substitution tilings and their associated-algebras". ''[[Ergodic Theory and Dynamical Systems]]'', v. 18, n. 3, p. 509–537, 1998.
*HERMAN, Richard H.; PUTNAM, Ian F.; SKAU, Christian F. "Ordered Bratteli diagrams, dimension groups and topological dynamics". ''[[International Journal of Mathematics]]'', v. 3, n. 06, p. 827–864, 1992.
*{{cite book | last=Putnam | first=Ian F. | title=Cantor Minimal Systems | publisher=American Mathematical Soc. | date=2018 | isbn=978-1-4704-4115-9}}
